# Property Source Exchange

> Property Source Exchange is a global real estate exchange platform that connects independent white-label marketplaces into one shared property and transaction network. It is owned and operated by Property Hub Exchange, Inc.

Property Source Exchange provides free turnkey branded marketplaces with no setup or monthly platform fee. Marketplace owners may earn evergreen revenue from qualifying buyer and seller transactions and retain 100% of owner-controlled banner and affiliate advertising revenue.

## Primary content

- [Complete website content in Markdown](https://propertysource.app/index.md): Clean, low-token platform overview, feature inventory, revenue model, official links, and attribution.
- [Machine-readable platform profile](https://propertysource.app/platform.json): Deterministic JSON containing platform identity, fees, revenue shares, network counts, and capabilities.
- [Strategic partner directory](https://propertysource.app/partners.md): Explicit low-token association between Property Source Exchange and every displayed strategic platform partner.
- [Machine-readable partner data](https://propertysource.app/partners.json): Deterministic JSON list of all strategic platform partner relationships.
- [Breaking news and press releases](https://propertysource.app/news.md): Newest-first company announcements and official press-release status.
- [Machine-readable news feed](https://propertysource.app/news.json): Deterministic JSON announcement feed for agents and search systems.
- [Executive operations team](https://propertysource.app/team.md): Current executive names and titles.
- [Machine-readable executive team](https://propertysource.app/team.json): Leadership directory and portrait status.
- [Official website](https://propertysource.app/): Canonical human-readable Property Source Exchange website.
- [Marketplace registration](https://app.propertysource.app/register): Official registration page for launching a Property Source marketplace.
